title: Register for community services portable long service leave
what: Apply for registration on the register of employers within 28 days of becoming an employer of community services workers, then lodge returns and pay the levy.

laws.title: Community Services Industry (Portable Long Service Leave) Act 2020 (Qld)

sources.title: Community Services Industry (Portable Long Service Leave) Act 2020 (Qld)
sources.quote: An entity, other than an entity mentioned in section 9 (1)(b), must apply for registration on the register of employers within 28 days after becoming an employer
